verdict.rationale: Dots documents connecting your own computer so that 'local files, code, and apps' are available for its work, and it can run local Work/Codex tasks using permitted repositories and developer tools. It also operates its own cloud computer and browser, which you can take over and hand back. However, the docs never say how it sees or controls local application interfaces, so the depth of on-device operation is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that it sees and operates GUI applications on the user's own machine, detail on supported apps and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work

citations.quote: Connect your computer once through your dot's profile to make its local files, code, and apps available for your dot's work.
Your dot can create local Work or Codex tasks and continue existing local Codex tasks.
Investigate bugs, implement changes, and run builds using permitted local repositories, developer tools, and skills.
your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser.
open its computer and select Take over. Select Return control when you're ready for your dot to continue.
